entities.summary: Zakarine was a monarchs & rulers in Luang Prabang (1840-07-16, Luang Prabang – 1904-03-25) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and empire and colonial dynamics. Established dynastic legacies and territorial boundaries.
